newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates remain and thinly quoted.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates remain and thinly quoted.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly steady on Friday amid light activity on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session on Friday.
No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 115 percent of tariff, unchanged from July 24, offer 120 percent, unchanged.
- Ten barges, Illinois River, two each week of August, no bid, offer 115 percent, unchanged from July 24.
- Five barges, McGregor and South, Mid-Mississippi River, one each week of August, bid 117-1/2 percent, down five percentage points from July 24, no offer.
- Four barges, Memphis through Cairo, Mississippi River, one each week of September, bid 135 percent, no comparison, no offer.
